title: The Great Divorce
author: C. S. Lewis
summary: The narrator boards a bus from a grey, drizzly town to the edge of heaven, where solid spirits try to persuade insubstantial ghosts to leave their old habits and join them.
readIf: you like short, imaginative Christian allegory and questions about choice and pride.
skipIf: you want a novel with a developed plot or are put off by religious themes.
